steps.title: Know your models
steps.html:
Type each gray word in the Filter models box.

@MODELS@

This list is also on the Canvas tab in VR.

steps.title: Go on location
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Playground in Filter environments. Click Playground, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the scene
steps.html:
Press the top button on your right controller, then click Models. Set up the Sun, Water Cycle, Frog, Eagle and Shovel as one exhibit, in a line or a circle.

✋ Grab a model with the palm trigger. Use both palm triggers to make it bigger or smaller.
🗣 Say it out loud: “The ___ connects to the ___ because ___.”

steps.title: Take the shot and send it
steps.html:
Stand back so the whole scene fits. Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Move the models, take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

studio.title: Season highlight reel

labels.start: Read the question. How is it connected?
labels.done: That's a wrap! Every frame shows a connection. Thank you for a great season, crew!

studio.look: Our season reel has six frames, one for each big idea from this spring. Each frame is a real photo. Connected means one thing changes or helps another.
studio.do: Read the question for each frame and tap the best answer. Each right answer lights a frame. Light all six to play the reel.

frames.lead: 1. What was your favorite connection this spring?

frames.starter: People can help nature by ___, because ___.

studio.full: You lit all 6 frames of the season reel. Your 2 sentences have at least 20 words.

reel.name: Plants
reel.q: A sunflower soaks up sunlight. What does the plant use it for?
reel.ok: Yes! Plants use sunlight to make food, and animals eat the plants.
reel.miss: Think about leaves. What do they make with sunlight?

reel.name: Matter
reel.q: The Sun warms a frozen puddle. What happens to the ice?
reel.ok: Yes! Heat melts the ice into water, and animals can drink it.
reel.miss: What does heat do to ice?

reel.name: Energy
reel.alt: Dark blue solar panels on a house roof
reel.q: A solar panel takes in sunlight. What does it make?
reel.ok: Yes! It turns light energy into electrical energy for people.
reel.miss: Think about what lights and fans need to run.

reel.name: Everglades
reel.alt: An alligator swimming in shallow green water near grass
reel.q: In the dry season, the gator hole holds the last water. Who does it help?
reel.ok: Yes! Fish, birds and the alligator all need that water.
reel.miss: In the dry season, who needs water to live?

reel.name: Adaptations
reel.alt: A bright green tree frog resting on a gray board
reel.q: A green tree frog is green like leaves. How does that help it?

options.hide: 🍃 It hides from animals that hunt it

reel.ok: Yes! Its color helps it hide from predators.
reel.miss: Think about camouflage. What does blending in do?

reel.name: Threats
reel.alt: A lionfish with long striped fins swimming over a reef
reel.q: Lionfish eat the little fish that keep algae off coral. What happens to the reef?
reel.ok: Yes! When one kind of fish is gone, the coral has a harder time too.
reel.miss: Who keeps the algae off the coral? What if they were eaten?

voice.brief: Welcome to the premiere, crew. We film Scene 33, Premiere Night. Show me how everything is connected, then take the shot.
voice.step1: Before your headset goes on, meet your five models. Learn each gray search word. You will type it in VR.
voice.step2: Put on your headset. Click Explore, type Gallery, and pick Optima Gallery. Then click Begin Solo.
voice.step3: Set up the sun, the water cycle, the frog, the eagle and the shovel. Then tell me how each one connects to the next.
voice.extra: Got time? Add a special guest to the premiere. That shot is just for VR crews.
voice.step4: Step back so the whole scene fits. Click Library, then Camera, and take the shot. Then send it to Canvas.
voice.step5: Press the Meta button and click Quit. Then open Canvas. Your photo should be waiting there.
